AWS Config or Amazon Inspector supplies evidence, Codex App Server explains sanitized facts, and a human controls any deterministic remediation before provider verification." data-long-description="The operator selects EC2, ECR, or S3 in the unified SecCop interface. Deterministic provider adapters read AWS Config or Amazon Inspector. SecCop binds and sanitizes those facts before a read-only Codex App Server investigation. Codex does not authorize or execute changes. svg.title: SecCop MVP: evidence, reasoning, human approval
svg.desc: An operator scans EC2, ECR, or S3 in SecCop. AWS Config or Amazon Inspector supplies evidence, Codex App Server explains sanitized facts, and a human controls any deterministic remediation before provider verification. The operator selects EC2, ECR, or S3 in the unified SecCop interface. Deterministic provider adapters read AWS Config or Amazon Inspector. SecCop binds and sanitizes those facts before a read-only Codex App Server investigation. Codex does not authorize or execute changes. A separate lower lane shows the exact proposal, human approve or reject decision, deterministic action, and fresh provider verification.
